conclusion: Candidate implementation direction is sound, but cannot be released because persistent memory and graph memory lack scope isolation and graph ingest does not defensively reject authoritative paths.
blockingGaps: PersistentNarrationMemoryStore.retrieve must filter by session_id/module_id by default; global seed memory needs explicit modeling.
SQLiteNarrationGraphMemory must include session/module scope in columns or entity ids and supersede/query within that scope only.
ingest_record must defensively reject authoritative paths using NarrativeState allowlist/denylist.
Vector memory patch supersession must stale old memories or retrieval must dedupe latest path memory.
Add architecture tests for cross-session isolation, graph authoritative path rejection, and runtime immutability.
deferred: SQLite migration/FK/WAL/close lifecycle can be later unless rubric requires it.
JSONL corruption recovery can be later but should remain QA gap.
Embedding/async writes/advanced conflict detection are out of scope.
